decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing extends the firm's drainage know-how into a new material, which is moderately less familiar but still related.
The floor-level shower drainage system builds directly on the firm's core drainage and shower solutions, so the firm can interpret and improve it.
The designer shower drainage product is a strategic flagship that builds on existing design and drainage capabilities, making a drop unlikely.
The shower element with integrated slope is adjacent to core drainage but involves broader building components, giving a low but nonzero drop risk.
The backflow-protected basement floor drain extends proven drainage technology with a protective function, closely related to existing know-how.
The air-admittance valve is somewhat outside the firm's core floor-level drainage expertise, so it has the highest drop risk among the related products.
